name: branding-navy-circular-text-badge-monogram-strip
title: Circular Text Badge Monogram on Navy
whatItIs: A wide navy strip with a small lilac pixelated monogram at the centre surrounded by a ring of white uppercase text reading a studio name, city and year.
whatItMeans: The circular text works like a seal, giving a small mark authority and a crafted feel.
techniques: Text set on a circle around a mark
Blocky monogram in lilac on deep navy
Separators as asterisks in the ring
Huge empty space to make it a stamp

vocabulary.definition: Lettering set along a circular path.
A round mark that signals authorship or authenticity.
A letter mark built from square blocks.
